in_marathi.name: Amrut
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of immortality
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amrut हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the divine elixir of immortality, Amrita, is referred to as Amrut. It is a symbol of purity, devotion, and the quest for eternal life.

in_bengali.name: Amrut
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Nectar of immortality
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amrut একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, the divine elixir of immortality, Amrita, is referred to as Amrut. It is a symbol of purity, devotion, and the quest for eternal life.
